answer: Work waits on the ocean until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the mesa of the next round. The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the sable is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
